not available for Colorado: CDOT screens with its own safety performance functions (Level of Service of Safety) by facility type and ADT, not average rates; CrashIQ has neither CDOT's SPFs nor Colorado traffic counts

Highway Safety Manual (AASHTO, 1st, 2010), Ch. 4, Sec. 4.2.3. Colorado's own method, CDOT identifies sites by Level of Service of Safety (SPFs with EB adjustment) and crash-pattern diagnostics, then ranks by benefit/cost (Colorado HSIP 2025 report, pp. 9-10 of 42), isn't built: this report uses the HSM critical rate against the corridor's own sites (national method)
not available for Colorado: CDOT's documents read here set no minimum; its crash-data page asks requesters for up to five years
